checks.text: The page displays the heading "Digital Drawing Canvas" and a toolbar containing buttons labelled "Brush", "Eraser", "Rectangle", and "Export PNG".
Clicking the button labelled "Add Layer" creates a new layer in the layer list; the new layer is named "Layer 2" and is selected by default.
With the "Brush" tool selected, clicking the button labelled "Export PNG" triggers a file download named "drawing.png".
Clicking the button labelled "Delete Layer" while "Layer 2" is selected removes "Layer 2" from the layer list; the layer list now contains only "Layer 1".
Typing "Hex" in the field labelled "Hex" and pressing Enter updates the color swatch to display the value "#ff0000" when "ff0000" is typed.
Clicking the button labelled "Undo" after drawing a stroke removes the most recent stroke from the canvas; the canvas is visually empty if no other strokes exist.
Selecting the "Eraser" tool and clicking on a drawn stroke removes that stroke from the canvas.
Clicking the button labelled "Zoom In" increases the zoom level indicator from "100%" to "110%".
Reload keeps the layer named "Layer 2" in the layer list and the color value "#ff0000" in the field labelled "Hex".
